title: Panel Rollout Scrub — Cliff Notes
content:
Meeting: Panel rollout scrub (quick cliff notes)
Date: 2026-03-16
Time: 09:30–10:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #console-rollouts
Attendees: Priya Rao (PM), Ethan Cole (FE), Marisol Vega (Telemetry), Lena Ho (SRE), Jayden Park (Analytics, joined 09:40)

Purpose:
- Quick pre-rollout scrub to confirm canary gating, telemetry coverage, and mitigations for the new panel feature (panel rendering + feature-flags + rollout circuit). Keep it short — block/unblock decisions only.

Agenda:
1) Canary gating review (owner: Priya)
2) Telemetry gaps and sampling plan (owner: Marisol)
3) UI regressions checklist and isolations (owner: Ethan)
4) Fallbacks + runbook refresh (owner: Lena)
5) Open questions / action sync (all)

Summary / Notes:
- Canary gating: We will run a 5% initial canary across dedicated internal teams for 2 hours, then expand to 20% for 4 hours if metrics stable. Gate criteria: no increase >0.5pp in route error-rate, p95 render latency increase < 120ms baseline, and no >1% uplift in user session dropoffs on the targeted routes.
- Feature-flag rollout plan: toggle name `panel_new_layout_v2`. Toggleed via gatekeeper service; rollout timeline is staged with automation (feature-flag API + rollout schedule). Priya confirmed API token is scoped to the runbook.
- Telemetry: Marisol flagged two missing events from the panel client: `panel_render_failed` (needs error code enums) and `panel_kvcache_miss`. Temporary shim added in FE branch to emit `panel_render_failed` with coarse error buckets until backend metrics are live. Sampling: 10% full traces for canary users, 0.5% baseline elsewhere.
- Analytics: Jayden will add a short ad-hoc Explore that tracks: user_id (hashed), route, panel_variant, render_time_ms, error_code, and session_outcome. Will also add an immediate regression dashboard with a 6-hour rolling window.
- UI regressions checklist: Ethan ran QA smoke and found 2 minor CSS regressions on narrow viewports and one accessibility label missing on the collapse button. He pushed quick fixes to PR 987; FE smoke passed on staging.
- Fallbacks/runbook: Lena updated runbook excerpt — immediate rollback path is: disable flag -> trigger cache invalidation job -> monitor p99 for 30m. Added an emergency rollback play that re-routes traffic to previous panel rendering service for dedicated capacity customers.

Decisions made:
- Proceed with 5% canary at 09:00 PT tomorrow with the listed gating thresholds.
- Emit `panel_render_failed` with coarse buckets now; follow-up to add structured errors by end of week.
- Sampling rate for traces during canary: 10% for canary cohort.
- Accessibility label fix merged to PR 987; will ship with canary.

Open Questions / Risks:
- Persisted state: unknown edge-case where old client + new server returns an inconsistent collapse state. Ethan to add a compatibility check in the client; if incompatible, flag user to not receive canary.
- Telemetry schema: backend ingestion needs to accept `panel_kvcache_miss` as integer count; Marisol to raise a short schema migration if ingestion rejects.
- Long-tail performance: we do not have p99 tokenization timing per-route yet (only p95). This might hide regressions for rare long sequences. Jayden to sketch an ad-hoc sampling for long sequences.

Action items (owner — due)
- Priya: Kick off canary at 09:00 PT tomorrow and monitor; prepare short comms for internal channels (done) — due 2026-03-17 09:00.
- Marisol: Add ingestion rule for `panel_kvcache_miss` and verify schema acceptance; post result in ticket INF-4123 — due 2026-03-18.
- Ethan: Push compatibility check to FE client to opt-out incompatible clients and add viewport CSS tweak; follow up in PR 987 — due 2026-03-17 EOD.
- Lena: Update runbook with emergency rollback play and verify the cache invalidation job idempotency (run a dry-run) — due 2026-03-18.
- Jayden: Create the 6-hour rolling regression dashboard and share link in #console-rollouts; include p99 render_time if possible — due 2026-03-17 noon.
- SRE oncall (assigned: Maya Singh): Stand by during canary window; verify autoscale policy doesn't trigger unintended shifts — oncall for 2026-03-17.

Post-meeting quick notes:
- Everyone agreed to keep the canary small and monitor early signs; we prioritized visibility over speed.
- If any of the gating thresholds break, the immediate action is to disable `panel_new_layout_v2` and run the rollback playbook.

Links referenced:
- INF-4123: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4123
- Runbook (live): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Panel+Rollout+Runbook
- PR with FE fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/987

Notes to self (Priya):
- Follow up with PMs owning mobile clients — ensure they are included in the compatibility check.
- Keep the first 2 hours strictly internal (no org-wide expansion) unless telemetry looks green.

End of cliff notes. Short, action-oriented. Will paste a cleaned version into the runbook and archive the detailed log after canary completes.
